title: Example Quest
objective: Coordinate the multi-session quest Example Quest from design through the hidden operator run, readback and a separate publication decision. Coordination only: content, rewards, art and engine rules keep their existing owners.
notes: Scaffolded by scripts/content_workstream.py new from template multisession v1.
Every task starts PLANNED or BLOCKED. Mark a task READY only when its inputs are committed and `validate` passes; refine, split or SKIP template tasks as the design requires.

resources.why: Precedence, evidence tiers and task routing; arbitrates every disagreement.
How to initialize, work and record a workstream task.
Routed content reference for this content type.

tasks.title: Design and objective graph
tasks.objective: Commit one durable design source for Example Quest: premise, objective graph, endings and the cast/asset list it implies.
scope: Write or point at one committed design source; do not restate it in this roadmap.
Name every ending, battle and reward path the graph needs, without choosing reward values.
Mark any older design packet or handoff bundle this source supersedes.
out_of_scope: Reward values, rarity and balance numbers.

required_resources.why: Graph and flow rules for this content type.
How user-owned choices are surfaced instead of settled.

deliverables: A committed design source path, added to this task's required_resources and evidence.
completion_gates: The design source is committed and named as path evidence.
The user has accepted the design scope; the acceptance is recorded with a committed source.
blockers: No committed design source exists for Example Quest yet. Commit one, add it to required_resources, then remove this blocker.
open_decisions: Scope, endings and premise of Example Quest are the user's to approve.

tasks.title: Source pins and capture inventory
tasks.objective: Inventory the live records, captures and source pins Example Quest depends on, and label the freshness and coverage of each.
scope: List every existing record the design reuses or edits, with the committed capture that shows it.
Record the game-source pin each contract claim relies on; a sentinel or stamped file is not a deployment proof.
Report name-collision coverage as collision / not seen in captured scope / unknown; never claim global uniqueness from a partial census.
List the captures still missing; requesting them is the operator's action.
out_of_scope: Any live read or write by an agent.

required_resources.why: Capture vs contract precedence and evidence tiers.

deliverables: A committed inventory of reused records, captures, source pins and missing captures.
completion_gates: The inventory is committed and every reused record names a committed capture or is listed as missing.

tasks.title: AI, item and reward decisions
tasks.objective: Obtain and record the user-owned enemy, item and reward decisions Example Quest needs before anything is built.
scope: Present each enemy/item/reward choice as options with consequences; the user decides.
Record each decision in a committed source (a ruling or decision file) and link it here.
Keep chance-based and guaranteed rewards distinct in every record.
out_of_scope: Choosing any value on the user's behalf.
deliverables: Committed decision records for every enemy, item and reward the design needs.
completion_gates: Every decision is recorded with a committed source; none is inferred from an existing live value.
open_decisions: Enemy stats, item mechanics, reward values, rarity and drop chances for Example Quest.

tasks.title: Player-facing prose
tasks.objective: Write and freeze the dialogue, objective text and descriptions Example Quest needs.
scope: All player-facing text named by the design source, in one committed prose source.
out_of_scope: Reward claims not yet recorded by admin.decisions.
deliverables: A committed prose source accepted by the user.
completion_gates: The prose source is committed and its user acceptance is recorded with a committed source.

tasks.title: Art production plan and assets
tasks.objective: Produce the art Example Quest needs through the existing art workflow, after splitting this task by asset class.
scope: Before any generation, replace this task with one task per asset class (scene characters, avatars, icons, backgrounds) as CONTENT_WORKSTREAM.md section 3 requires; never one task per image.
Reuse approved art where it exists; do not redraw approved bytes.
Track each asset from raw approval to production acceptance, binding and readback; raw approval alone is not acceptance.
out_of_scope: Mixing asset classes in one generation session.

required_resources.why: Art direction, generation, QC and handoff workflow.

deliverables: Committed, preflighted asset files with recorded user acceptance, or SKIPPED with the reason.
completion_gates: Every asset is committed and passes the art preflight.
User acceptance of each asset class is recorded with a committed source.

tasks.title: Manifest build and validation
tasks.objective: Construct and validate the hidden manifest for Example Quest from the committed design, decision, prose and art sources.
scope: Construct payloads with factory.py from the committed sources; hand-authoring is the fallback.
Every entity ships hidden.
Run validate.py and the Forge offline check and record both results.
out_of_scope: Running the manifest against the game.

required_resources.why: Manifest format, push path and readback contract.
Content rules the manifest must satisfy.

deliverables: A committed manifest under push/ with its validator output.
completion_gates: validate.py reports zero errors from the skill data/ directory, or an exact SHA-scoped exception is approved by ruling.
forge/tools/check_manifest.mjs exits 0 on the committed manifest.

tasks.title: Independent review
tasks.objective: Independently review the frozen manifest SHA when the scope calls for it; otherwise mark SKIPPED with the reason.
scope: Review the exact frozen SHA, not a branch name.
Record findings and their disposition in a committed review file.
deliverables: A committed review file naming the reviewed SHA, or SKIPPED with the reason.
completion_gates: The review names the exact reviewed SHA and every blocking finding is closed.

tasks.title: Hidden operator run and readback
tasks.objective: The operator runs the hidden manifest; the committed results and a fresh readback show what actually landed.
scope: The operator alone runs the manifest; no agent touches the game.
Commit the results bundle and a fresh readback capture.
Classify every entity as match, drift, unverified or failed/partial; an HTTP 200 or push echo is not a readback.
deliverables: A committed results bundle and readback capture, with any partial failure named.
completion_gates: Results and readback captures are committed and every entity has a readback classification.

tasks.title: Hidden testing and calibration
tasks.objective: Test Example Quest while hidden and record any calibration the user approves as a new decision and repair manifest.
scope: Record test findings in a committed file.
Any value change goes back through admin.decisions and a new validated manifest.
deliverables: Committed test findings and, where approved, a repair manifest.
completion_gates: Findings are committed and the user has accepted the hidden result, recorded with a committed source.

tasks.title: Publication decision
tasks.objective: The user decides whether and when Example Quest is unhidden and announced.
scope: Record the publication decision and, if published, the post-publication readback.
out_of_scope: Any agent unhiding, publishing or posting.
completion_gates: The decision is recorded with a committed source.
open_decisions: Whether and when Example Quest is published; this is the user's alone.
